title: Failure Prism: integrated latency-signal heatmap and trace-hook taxonomy
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Build a combined failure taxonomy and interactive heatmap (the 'Failure Prism') that surfaces latency and error slices across routes, model variants, and backend layers. This ticket scopes the tracing-hook additions, metric/log pipeline mapping, and the Grafana heatmap/dashboard panels. Primary categories in the taxonomy: 1) Client/Network timeouts, 2) Overload/backpressure (queueing + dropped requests), 3) Model-execution errors (OOM/invalid state/kernels), 4) Runtime preemption & infra failures, 5) Protocol errors and codes (HTTP 5xx/4xx, gRPC CANCELLED/DEADLINE_EXCEEDED/UNAVAILABLE), 6) Degraded responses (truncated/partial tokens), 7) Upstream dependency errors (auth/kv/cache).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Trace hooks implemented on request entry/exit with standardized failure_code and latency_ms tags; 2) Metric pipeline maps trace.failure_code -> histogram/summary and emits a latency-by-route-model histogram; 3) Grafana dashboard with a heatmap of median/95th latency by (route x model) with filterable failure categories and status-code overlays; 4) Drilldown links from any heatmap cell to the top-50 traces and a prefilled search that shows corresponding logs and spans; 5) Runbook snippets appear as a contextual panel for high-severity cells (customer_impact >= high).
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Define taxonomy enum and trace/span attribute names; add instrumentation in gateway and model-proxy to set trace.tags: failure_code, failure_category, model_variant, route_name, queue_time_ms, kv_cache_hit. Phase 2: Update metric pipeline to derive metrics from traces (trace->metric transform) and emit Prometheus/MetricWriter counters and histograms. Phase 3: Create Grafana panels: heatmap, stacked bar for failure categories, percentile sparklines per model, and trace-link context. Phase 4: QA with synthetic fault injections (timeout, OOM, 429-saturation) and validate signal fidelity. Phase 5: Rollout: canary dashboard and instrumentation behind feature flag; codify runbook playbooks for top-3 failure types.
telemetry_signals: Instrumented trace attributes: failure_code (string), failure_category (string from taxonomy), latency_ms (number), queue_ms (number), model_variant (string), route (string), backend_status (HTTP/gRPC code), kv_cache_hit (true|false). Derived metrics: latency_histogram_{route}_{model}, failure_count_by_category, protocol_error_rate, queue_depth_gauge, ooms_per_hour. Alerts: error-rate > 1% for P1 customers, latency_p95 > SLA threshold per route.
dashboard_notes: Design the Failure Prism heatmap with: x-axis = model_variant (group similar quantizations together), y-axis = route (API path or feature), cell color = p95 latency normalized to SLA, cell overlay = stacked failure-category mini bar. Filters: time range, region, customer_tier, deployment type (hosted/dedicated/private). Add on-hover quick actions: open traces (with pre-applied filter), open logs (log query), link to PRs and recent deploys. Ensure panels respect RBAC (only show private deploy IDs to authorized roles).
